notes: Ledger of every art asset. Only CC0, generic art from no existing game. Maintained by art-engineer; checked by a Vitest validator and a CI size check (issue #80). Names are lowercase snake_case with mesh_, tex_, anim_ or sfx_ prefixes. Statuses: planned, ready, used. Entries may carry a free-text notes field. Paths are where the processed file will be placed; originals are not committed (listed by URL in Art/README.md).

assets.name: mesh_ghost
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Built by Art/scripts/build_ghost.mjs from UAL1_Standard.glb (mannequin, clips) and UAL2_Standard.glb (ClimbUp_1m). One skinned primitive, 3,600 tris, 23 joints (finger joints merged into the hands), one 512 px PNG palette atlas embedded (1.6 KB), no external files. Scale baked so the model is 1.8 m tall, feet at y=0, faces +z at yaw 0 (Babylon's glTF root keeps +z facing +z). Bind pose is a T-pose (about 1.9 m wide); play a clip before showing it. Gear: hood with violet visor strip, harness straps, chest buckle, belt and pouches, violet left armband, gloves, boots, knee pads. No weapon. Clips: idle, walk, run, jump, fall, land, hit, crouch_idle, crouch_walk, mantle (UAL2 ClimbUp_1m; it carries upward pelvis motion). Not included, to be posed procedurally in client code: climb, hang, shimmy.

assets.name: mesh_warden
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Built by Art/scripts/build_warden.mjs from UAL1_Standard.glb. KayKit Mannequin_Medium (the original plan) was rejected: cartoon proportions (head half the body height), a smiley face and a printed name tag with text. One skinned primitive, 4,337 tris, 23 joints, one embedded 512 px PNG palette atlas, no external files. #95 bulk pass: clearly broader than the Ghost at range (soft radial scaling about 1.3 to 1.65 on torso, 1.5 on upper arms, 1.35 on legs and boots; torso about 1.5x the Ghost's width), shoulder pads, knee pads, back pack, collar, rounder bigger helmet, vest shell, chest and back plates, orange visor, comms, radio, flashlight mount (static, right shoulder, orange lens), belt, pouches. Joint positions are unchanged, so the rifle mount on hand_r is unchanged (re-verified in Babylon with idle_rifle and run_rifle: rifle sits in both hands). 1.8 m tall, feet at y=0, faces +z at yaw 0. Bind pose is a T-pose; play a clip before showing it. Clips: idle, walk, run, jump, fall, land, hit, idle_rifle (Pistol_Idle_Loop), walk_rifle and run_rifle (locomotion legs plus the held Pistol_Aim_Neutral upper body), fire (Pistol_Shoot), reload (Pistol_Reload). The rifle clips use the UAL two-handed pistol poses; the left hand holds near the grip, not the foregrip.

assets.name: mesh_rifle
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Built by Art/scripts/build_rifle.mjs from Gun_Rifle.gltf. The source atlas has small printed serial text, so it is not shipped: triangles are recoloured from a 512 px flat palette atlas (dark, mid, light, orange). 1,393 tris, 0.9 m long, muzzle toward +z, origin at the barrel's underside at the rear (y up). Nodes: muzzle [0,0.18,0.9], grip [0,0.07,0.22], light_mount [0,0.10,0.72] (visual anchor only, no geometry). Third-person attach (checked in Babylon with idle_rifle): TransformNode mount parented to the Warden's hand_r node, position (-0.0037,-0.1641,-0.0281), rotationQuaternion (-0.0066,0.7695,0.6381,0.0249), scaling 1, then the loaded rifle root parented to mount. Source says CC0; no logo or readable text remains. The Ghost has no weapon art.

assets.name: mesh_console
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: From Prop_Computer.gltf (446 tris now). The kit textures are NOT used: flat palette materials. Nodes: root mesh_console with children body (materials steel, bezel) and screen (a clean 0.56 x 0.28 quad on the 45 degree screen plane, material screen, UVs 0..1 so tex_screen_idle, tex_screen_off and tex_screen_hacked fit; the original decal geometry and its T_Decals texture are gone, so there is no printed text). Swap the screen look with emissiveTexture = glyph, emissiveColor white, albedo black, texture created with invertY false. About 0.74 x 1.59 x 0.56 m, origin at the base, the front (+z in the glb) faces the user.

assets.name: tex_concrete_smooth
assets.author: Lennart Demes and ambientCG contributors
assets.notes: Source Concrete034, 1K-JPG. 1024 px. Light smooth poured concrete, regraded to a cold grey (mean about 150) so upper walls stay light enough for a dark Ghost to read against (rule 7). Use on upper walls. Three files: _albedo (sRGB), _normal (OpenGL / glTF convention, Y up: set invertNormalMapY = true on a Babylon PBRMaterial in the default left-handed scene) and _orm (R occlusion, G roughness clamped to 0.35..0.97 so nothing is mirror-like, B metal). Tileable; use world-unit UVs, one tile per 2 m. Built by Art/scripts/build_textures.mjs.
